The transactional email provider key is older than a year and sits in two places. Create a new SendGrid API key with send-only scope, update the secret in the relay's config, redeploy, and revoke the old key after one clean day.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] new key created, send-only
- [ ] relay config updated and deployed
- [ ] old key revoked, deadline: end of the month
